title: Participle Clauses
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Las 'Participle Clauses' te permiten acortar oraciones y sonar increíblemente formal y profesional en correos o presentaciones de alto nivel.

parts.visual:
Se usan para conectar ideas de forma elegante (sustituyen a 'Because', 'After', 'When'): 
1. Participio Presente (-ING): Para acciones simultáneas o causas activas. 
Ej: (Because he was) Feeling tired, he left the meeting. 
(Sintiéndose cansado, se fue de la reunión). 
Ej: (When she was) Walking to the office, she saw the CEO.
parts.audio: We use Participle Clauses to connect ideas elegantly. They often replace 'Because', 'After', or 'When'. Present Participles ending in i n g are used for simultaneous actions or active causes. For example: Feeling tired, he left the meeting. Another example: Walking to the office, she saw the C E O.

parts.visual:
2. Participio Pasado (-ED / 3ra columna): Para causas pasivas. 
Ej: (Because it was) Manufactured in Germany, the machine is very reliable. 
(Fabricada en Alemania, la máquina es muy fiable). 
3. Perfect Participle (Having + Participio Pasado): Para mostrar que una acción terminó antes que otra. 
Ej: (After we had) Having signed the contract, we celebrated. 
(Habiendo firmado el contrato, lo celebramos).
parts.audio: Past Participles ending in e d or the third column are used for passive causes. For example: Manufactured in Germany, the machine is very reliable. Perfect Participles, which use 'Having' plus a past participle, show that one action finished before another. For example: Having signed the contract, we celebrated.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el participio correcto para acortar la oración formalmente.

questions.question: ____ the email, I realized I had made a mistake. (Mientras leía).
____ in 1990, the company has grown into a global empire. (Habiendo sido fundada / Fundada).
questions.explanation: Participio pasado (pasivo): Because it was founded in 1990 -> Founded in 1990.

questions.question: ____ the meeting, we all went out for a drink. (Habiendo terminado - acción completada antes).
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle: Having + participio. Indica que primero terminó la reunión y luego fuimos.

questions.question: ____ by the delay, the client cancelled the order. (Frustrado).
questions.explanation: Pasivo: Because he was frustrated -> Frustrated by the delay.

questions.question: ____ the true cost of the project, they decided to cancel it. (Al darse cuenta / Dándose cuenta - activo).
____ all his options, the manager finally made a decision. (Habiendo considerado - acción terminada antes).
questions.explanation: Primero consideró las opciones, luego decidió: Having considered.

questions.question: ____ with care, this machine will last for 20 years. (Si es usada / Usada).
questions.explanation: Pasivo (If it is used -> Used with care).

questions.question: Not ____ what to do, she called the IT department. (No sabiendo).
____ in the newspaper, the article caused a scandal. (Publicado).
____ the password, he couldn't log into the system. (Habiendo olvidado - previo a no poder).
questions.explanation: Primero olvidó la contraseña, luego no pudo entrar: Having forgotten.

questions.question: ____ at the screen all day gives me a headache. (El estar mirando - sujeto de la oración).
questions.explanation: Aquí funciona como sujeto (Gerundio): Looking at the screen...

questions.question: ____ by a team of experts, the software is bug-free. (Desarrollado).
____ late for the meeting, I apologized to the CEO. (Llegando tarde / Al llegar).
____ her presentation, she asked for questions. (Habiendo completado).
questions.explanation: Perfect Participle para mostrar secuencia: Having completed.

questions.question: ____ on a true story, the movie is very inspiring. (Basada).
____ a good reputation, the company attracts top talent. (Teniendo).
questions.explanation: Activo continuo: Because it has a good reputation -> Having a good reputation.

questions.question: ____ out of money, the startup had to declare bankruptcy. (Habiéndose quedado sin dinero).
____ in China, these phones are very cheap. (Hechos / Fabricados).
____ the room, he noticed everyone was looking at him. (Al entrar / Entrando).
Not ____ invited, I didn't go to the conference. (No habiendo sido invitado / Al no ser).
questions.explanation: Pasivo + Perfect: Not having been invited (Porque no había sido invitado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el participio correcto del verbo entre paréntesis (terminado en -ing o -ed/3ra columna).

questions.question: ____ (Read) the report, I found an error. (Leyendo/Al leer)
____ (Found) in 2005, it is a great company. (Fundada)
____ (Know) the risks, we invested anyway. (Sabiendo)
____ (Exhaust) by the trip, he slept for 12 hours. (Agotado)
____ (Use) properly, it will last years. (Usado/Si se usa)
____ (Walk) to work, I saw John. (Caminando)
____ (Make) of plastic, it is very light. (Hecho)
Not ____ (know) what to do, I asked for help. (No sabiendo)
____ (Drive) too fast, he crashed. (Manejando)
____ (Base) on data, this is the best option. (Basado)
